title: FSL ProbTrackX2

avoid_mp.desc: reject pathways passing through locations given by this mask

colmask4.desc: Mask for columns of matrix4 (default=seed mask)

correct_path_distribution.desc: correct path distribution for the length of the pathways

dist_thresh.desc: discards samples shorter than this threshold (in mm - default=0)

distthresh1.desc: Discards samples (in matrix1) shorter than this threshold (in mm - default=0)

distthresh3.desc: Discards samples (in matrix3) shorter than this threshold (in mm - default=0)

fibst.desc: force a starting fibre for tracking - default=1, i.e. first fibre orientation. Only works if randfib==0

fopd.desc: Other mask for binning tract distribution

force_dir.desc: use the actual directory name given - i.e. do not add + to make a new directory

inv_xfm.desc: transformation matrix taking DTI space to seed space (compulsory when using a warp_field for seeds_to_dti)

loop_check.desc: perform loop_checks on paths - slower, but allows lower curvature threshold

lrtarget3.desc: Column-space mask used for Nxn connectivity matrix

mask.desc: bet binary mask file in diffusion space

meshspace.desc: Mesh reference space - either "caret" (default) or "freesurfer" or "first" or "vox"

n_steps.desc: number of steps per sample - default=2000

network.desc: activate network mode - only keep paths going through at least one seed mask (required if multiple seed masks)

omatrix4.desc: Output matrix4 - DtiMaskToSeed (special Oxford Sparse Format)

onewaycondition.desc: Apply waypoint conditions to each half tract separately

out_dir.desc: directory to put the final volumes in

rand_fib.desc: options: 0 - default, 1 - to randomly sample initial fibres (with f > fibthresh), 2 - to sample in proportion fibres (with f>fibthresh) to f, 3 - to sample ALL populations at random (even if f<fibthresh)

s2tastext.desc: output seed-to-target counts as a text file (useful when seeding from a mesh)

sample_random_points.desc: sample random points within seed voxels

seed.desc: seed volume(s), or voxel(s) or freesurfer label file

seed_ref.desc: reference vol to define seed space in simple mode - diffusion space assumed if absent

simple.desc: rack from a list of voxels (seed must be a ASCII list of coordinates)

stop_mask.desc: stop tracking at locations given by this mask file

target2.desc: Low resolution binary brain mask for storing connectivity distribution in matrix2 mode

target3.desc: Mask used for NxN connectivity matrix (or Nxn if lrtarget3 is set)

target_masks.desc: list of target masks - required for seeds_to_targets classification

verbose.desc: Verbose level, [0-2]. Level 2 is required to output particle files.

wayorder.desc: Reject streamlines that do not hit waypoints in given order. Only valid if waycond=AND

waypoints.desc: waypoint mask or ascii list of waypoint masks - only keep paths going through ALL the masks

xfm.desc: transformation matrix taking seed space to DTI space (either FLIRT matrix or FNIRT warp_field) - default is identity

description: Use FSL  probtrackx2 for tractography on bedpostx results
